「それでも連れて帰る。俺は一人で帰る気はないからな」
考えるまでもない。
今の自分には、それ以外の選択肢なんて存在しない。

pages.en:
“Even so, I'm taking you home. I'm not going back alone.”

There is nothing to consider.

I have no other choice. Not anymore.

pages.en:
“————”

Illya says nothing. She only stares at me, dazed.

I take her unguarded hand.

“Come on, Illya. Let's get home before they find us.”

Drawing her tiny, far-too-light body toward me, I start walking.

pages.ja:
「呆れた。シロウには何を言っても無駄ね」
イリヤは抵抗せずにトテトテと歩き出し、
「ほんとに。こんなの、上手くいくはずないのに」
そっと、幸福そうに、俺の手を握り返した。

pages.en:
“Honestly. Telling you anything is a waste of breath, Shirou.”

Illya offers no resistance. She patters along beside me.

“Really. There's no possible way this can work.”

Then, gently, almost happily, she squeezes my hand in return.
